0.headline: Twenty-one names, zero votes cast, five very different bets
0.overview: Everybody sits on 0 points with 114 on the table, so the only thing to judge tonight is taste. Austin bunched picks #5, #6, #15 and #16 into a back-to-back double dip — livestock and lenses, exactly as advertised. Kylie went professional muscle from Aaliyah at #3 down to Kilby at #18. Tami opened the entire draft with Jelly at #1, then stacked five bodies knowing only her best four count. Taylor cornered the drama market with crisis management, a trainer, a voice actress and a pro wrestler. Tim just quietly took two farmers, an actor and a medical student.

lines.text: Austin owned the turn with Linnea at #5 and Jenna at #6, then doubled again at #15 and #16 for Carter and Eric — a roster built in two matched pairs.
Kylie grabbed Aaliyah third overall and kept hiring: HR at #8, a criminal defense attorney at #13, a game designer at #18 — that's a boardroom that knows how to read a room.
Tami had the first pick of the entire draft and spent it on Jelly, then used the snake's belly at #10, #11, #20 and the #21 leftover to carry five castaways when only four count.
Taylor took 49-year-old Kristin at #2 and then assembled a physical, loud, camera-ready four with Ori, Ana and Brady at #19 — the Crisis Cage Match name is doing honest work.
Tim opened with Lewis at #4, went right back to the field for Maggie at #7, and closed with Devin and Thien An — no gimmicks, just people who work.

awards.label: Boldest draft
awards.text: Taking the #21 leftover and stretching to five castaways with Rob at #20 is a swing nobody else was willing to take.

awards.label: Safest draft
awards.text: Two farmers, an actor and a medical student is the least flashy roster on the board and probably the hardest to knock over.
